queries.title: Which BREC classes sit directly under a CRM family class?
queries.intro: Every BREC class is anchored in CIDOC CRM, CRMdig or CRMinf. This lists the direct anchors; classes that reach the family only through another BREC class do not appear here (see the CRM coverage page).

queries.title: Identification hypotheses, ranked by confidence
queries.intro: The confidence is a subjective estimate by the AI assistant, not a measurement. Hypotheses overlap and do not sum to 1.

queries.title: Which evidence was used for which identification?
queries.intro: An identification (crminf:I5 Inference Making) uses evidence as a premise and concludes a hypothesis.

queries.title: Which beliefs of the AI assistant did a person adopt, and on what evidence?
queries.intro: A belief adoption (crminf:I7) is the act in which a person takes over a belief on the strength of evidence. The belief value (crminf:I6) is the confidence of the AI assistant. A hypothesis without an adoption is still a conjecture.
queries.sparql:
SELECT ?hypothesis ?value ?adoptedBy ?date ?evidence WHERE {
  ?a a crminf:I7_Belief_Adoption ; crminf:J2_concluded_that ?h ; crm:P14_carried_out_by ?p ; dct:date ?date ; crminf:J7_is_based_on_evidence_from ?e .
  ?h rdfs:label ?hypothesis ; crminf:J5_holds_to_be/rdf:value ?value .
  FILTER(LANG(?hypothesis) = "en")
  ?p rdfs:label ?adoptedBy .
  ?e rdfs:label ?evidence . FILTER(LANG(?evidence) = "en")
}

queries.title: Scans: when, with what, how many photos, where
queries.intro: The scan events of the two pyramids with device, photo count and the Wikidata item of the place.

queries.title: The four FDOx: concept DOI, title and pinned version
queries.intro: The identity of an FDOx is its concept DOI; the pinned version DOI is the registry pin.

queries.title: Which 3D models belong to which pyramid?
queries.intro: hdt:has_3D_model links a LEGO model to its raw scan and to the reconstruction.
queries.sparql:
SELECT ?pyramid ?model ?type WHERE {
  ?p a brec:BrickModel ; rdfs:label ?pyramid ; ?has ?m .
  FILTER(STRENDS(STR(?has), "has_3D_model") && LANG(?pyramid) = "en")
  ?m a ?type ; rdfs:label ?model .
  FILTER(LANG(?model) = "en")
}
ORDER BY ?pyramid ?model
